result.summary: This is a residential street with row houses and a wide, unmarked roadway that lacks formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure. While sidewalks are present, they are narrow and frequently interrupted by private driveways, and parked vehicles along the curb create significant visual obstructions for anyone attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb line block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians, particularly children, who might step into the street from between cars.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street where red and white cars are parked.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks or signage fails to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians in this residential context.

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The wide, open pavement without lane markings can encourage higher vehicle speeds than appropriate for a residential neighborhood.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond parked cars.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with continental striping to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical speed control measures to maintain low vehicle speeds consistent with residential land use.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk across a side street. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, there is no marked crossing for the main roadway, and parked vehicles may obstruct sightlines.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Cars parked close to the intersection corner may block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Missing crossing on main road
hazards.description: There is no marked crosswalk or pedestrian infrastructure to facilitate crossing the primary two-lane roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main road in the foreground and center.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk on Main Road
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility crosswalk across the main road to provide a designated space for pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and continuous sidewalks in a residential setting. However, the lack of traffic control devices and the presence of parked cars near the crossing create potential visibility and safety issues for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Restricted Sightlines
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corner may obstruct the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image near the crosswalk entrance.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks accompanying stop signs or signals to regulate vehicle flow at this wide intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection across the main roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian crossing warning signs to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.

result.summary: This residential street features row housing with a separated walkway, but lacks standard roadside pedestrian infrastructure. High levels of on-street parking create significant visual obstructions between the sidewalk area and the roadway.

hazards.description: A continuous line of parked vehicles along the curb obscures the view of pedestrians attempting to enter the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, between the houses and the travel lane.

hazards.name: Lack of marked pedestrian crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross the street, increasing exposure risk.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible length of the roadway.
